spans.s:
षोढा Ind. In six ways.
 E. षष् six, उ substituted for the final, धाच् aff.,
and ध changed to ढ.

सोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
 1. Borne, suffered, endured.
 2. Patient, enduring.
E. सह् to bear, aff. क्त ।

सोढृ mfn. (-ढा-ढ्री-ढृ)
 1. Patient, enduring.
 2. Able, powerful.
 E. सह् to bear, &c., aff. तृच् ।
